name: GenerateHKDFKey
description: Generates derived key material using HKDF (HMAC-based Key Derivation Function). Used in TLS 1.3, Signal Protocol, etc.
syntax: GenerateHKDFKey( string algorithm, any inputKeyMaterial, any salt, any info, numeric outputLength )

params.name: algorithm
params.description: Hash algorithm: SHA256, SHA384, or SHA512

params.name: salt
params.description: Salt value (can be empty string or null)

params.name: info
params.description: Context/application info (can be empty string or null)
